name: VItamin CVAE (Gabbard et al. 2022)
source: Paper Table III (layer sizes of the three networks r_theta1, r_theta2 and q_phi) and the Network design text; Fig. 1 gives the wiring.
unknowns: The three networks (encoder r1(z|y), decoder r2(x|y,z), recognition q(z|x,y)) share the six convolutions and the three FC widths and differ in the appended vector (z for r2, x for q, nothing for r1: 6144 -> 6159 inputs) and in the last FC layer (960, 30 and 30 units); the diagram draws the shared path and gives those last-layer sizes in the head's row and in notes.
The text says dropout and batch-normalisation layers are added, but Table III lists none; they are not drawn.
The sampling of z from the Gaussian mixture and the von Mises, von Mises-Fisher and truncated-Gaussian output distributions are not layers and are not drawn.
notes: Last FC layer per network: r1 FC(1024,960) linear -> [15,32,2] mixture means and log-variances; r2 FC(1024,30) sigmoid/negative-ReLU -> [19,2]; q FC(1024,30) linear -> [15,2]. L2 regularisation 0.001 on every convolution kernel.
